name: labs/hrosiak__esp301
title: Newport ESP 301 stepper motion controller (esp.esp)
intro: Newport ESP 301 stepper motion controller (esp.esp), adapted from hrosiak/esp301. It reads `position` and `last_error`; sets `target_position`; runs `reset_axis`. `reset_axis`: reset the served axis with the upstream reset (OR, WS0) and report whether the controller returns no error afterwards. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/hrosiak__esp301 --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/hrosiak__esp301 --backend fake --mcp
